svg.title: Controls (tp::controls): the easy and pro layouts and the clutch assist

g.text: Controls (tp::controls): the easy and pro layouts and the clutch assist
const vehicle::Params&, const vehicle::State&, dt_s) : vehicle::Input
steering (both layouts, by their params): the control past steer_dead_zone,
stretched to -1..1, followed at up to steer_rate_per_s (AssistState::steering;
at once with no rate, the default ProParams)
pro: steering x max angle; pedals pass through (held to 0..1)
|steering| <= steer_share turns the wheels to full lock;
beyond it, full lock and the inner rear brake from 0 to full pedal
guard = max(min(guard_share x rated, full-fuel speed at this throttle), stall + band)
assist: in at 1/engage_time while the engine is at or above the guard speed;
below it, out at up to 1/release_time (full rate a band below);
out at full rate when lifting off, in neutral or before a gear change;
the new gear (held to the gearbox) goes in once the clutch is out
